name: Weboptimizer - Text Normalization Layer (deterministic, NO LLM)

meta.templateNote: HARDCODED NORMALIZATION LAYER. Respects translation accents: the PROTECT list keeps accented names / non-translatable words (José, Galápagos, Ñandú) accented even in aggressive mode, transliterating only the rest. This is a pure Code node - NO LLM, no HTTP, no randomness - so it is deterministic and idempotent: the same input always yields the same output, and running it twice changes nothing. It is the JavaScript twin of .claude/skills/text-normalizer/scripts/normalize.py and MUST stay behavior-identical to it (same character tables, same order). Drop this node at the TOP of any stage that receives LLM-generated or human-pasted text (Optimizing, Humanizing, Templating), before the text is written to Airtable/Drive or benchmarked, so no zero-width space, non-breaking space, BOM, bidi mark, or control character ever reaches the database or the published page. Input: expects each item to carry a `text` field (change INPUT_FIELD/OUTPUT_FIELD below to match your record). Set MODE = 'content-safe' for anything that will be published (keeps accents: José, Galápagos), or 'aggressive' ONLY for NLP tokens / search keys / dedup hashes (lossy: folds accents, drops punctuation, lowercases). If you prefer to call the Python script instead of this JS twin, replace this node with an Execute Command node running: python3 .claude/skills/text-normalizer/scripts/normalize.py --file {{tmpfile}} [--aggressive] - identical output. A `_normalization` report is attached to each item for audit dashboards.

nodes.name: Normalize Text (hardcoded, no LLM)
nodes.notes: Deterministic + idempotent. Set MODE = 'aggressive' only for NLP/search keys (lossy). content-safe keeps accents (José, Galápagos) and paragraph structure while deleting zero-width spaces, non-breaking spaces, BOMs, bidi marks and control chars. Must stay behavior-identical to .claude/skills/text-normalizer/scripts/normalize.py - if you change one, change both and run test_normalize.py.
